title: Concept: Operating-system command executed from a string in erlang — review required
description: In erlang, os:cmd runs a shell command. The call is convenient in release scripts and then appears in request handlers where the string is assembled from parameters. Erlang gives no automatic escaping, so quoting is the only barrier.
applicability: erlang nodes and release scripts that call system tools.
risk: Shell injection with node privileges; HIGH severity.
